FULLSTACK DEVELOPER



Location: Dallas, TX
Compensation: $140,000-$160,000, competitive startup comp, and meaningful equity upside
Department: Engineering
Reports to: CTO




ABOUT RARE CANDY

Rare Candy is revolutionizing the $25 billion trading-card industry as the “friendly local game shop” in the palm of your hands. Collectors use our AI-powered card scanner, open their favorite chase cards with Instapacks, and keep track of them with our data-rich collection tools which showcases Pokémon, MTG, Lorcana, One Piece, and more. We've hit 10x revenue growth over the last 6 months, the business is profitable, and we're building the team to take this from a great product to a category-defining one.



We're a 10-person product team moving fast and looking for the next set of TCG-obsessed rock stars to join our team.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a Fullstack Developer to help build the operations toolchain we use every day to manage our warehouse, inventory, and managing our Instapacks business.



You'll work closely with the CTO and engineering team to ship new tools and features for our operations team. This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who loves solving logistic problems, has a background in GO and React, and wants to grow quickly inside a fast-moving startup.



You won't be handed endless tickets in a giant backlog. You'll work on real problems, learn from phenomenal backend engineers, and see your work go directly into the hands of passionate collectors.



If you love trading cards or collector communities, this is a role for you.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: You get the various ops tools running locally, understand the core problems, and ship your first meaningful fixes or small features.



By day 90: You're regularly shipping features for our Ops team with support from the CTO and principal engineer. You can take a well-scoped feature or improvement, ask the right questions, implement it cleanly, test it, and get it into the team's hands.



By the end of year one: You've become the main point of contact for the most important part of our Instapack business. You've shipped meaningful improvements to our Ops toolchain, grown your Go and React craft, and earned ownership over increasingly business critical items.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and improve our Ops toolchain to help support our entire Warehouse and Logistics team.

 - Fix bugs, improve bottlenecks, and raise the quality bar for Ops toolchain.

 - Work closely with ops and engineering to increase efficiency to hard problems.

 - Learn quickly, ask good questions, and communicate clearly when something is blocked, unclear, or ready for review.




A DAY IN YOUR LIFE AT RARE CANDY

You start the morning checking in with the warehouse team and reviewing feedback on a feature you shipped yesterday.



Mid-morning, you're pairing with other engineers on making improvements on various backend services.



After lunch, you're tightening up a dashboard, fixing an edge case, and testing the flow against real time operations.



Later in the day, you're in an operations discussion about how we want to launch a new game for Instapacks and how our toolchain needs to support it.



You close the day by opening a PR with a clear summary, and a note about what still needs review.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You have around 3-5 years of fullstack development experience with Go.

 - You're comfortable building with React or other React frameworks.

 - You've worked with GraphQL, or you have enough API experience to ramp quickly.

 - You care about product quality and the little details that make tools easy to use and feel good.

 - You have experience building internal tools and understand the importance of understanding the customer to build the right thing.

 - You're comfortable in a fast-moving startup where priorities can shift and the best answer is often “figure it out, then make it better.”

 - You know the trading-card or collector world. You collect, play, rip packs, follow the market, or have real fluency in a similar collectible space.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO THRIVE HERE

You’re expected to take ownership of your role at Rare Candy and drive your own growth. That doesn’t mean doing it alone. You’ll have support, context, and mentorship along the way.



The systems are still evolving, the team is small, and your work will matter immediately. You'll need to be curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning by doing.



If you like to build internal tools, solve operational issues, and the idea of building tools you would actually want to use yourself, you'll do great here.




WHY JOIN US NOW

 - Work on features collectors actually care about and are using everyday.

 - Get real ownership early in your career while learning directly from experienced engineering leadership.

 - Join a high-trust, low-ego team that ships fast, celebrates wins, and cares deeply about the hobby.

 - Competitive startup comp, meaningful equity upside, and a salary range of $140,000-$160,000.

 - Full benefits: health, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and a wellness stipend.

 - A monthly dogfooding budget to spend on cards, because we hire people who love this hobby.




HOW TO APPLY

Apply through our Ashby posting and answer these:

 - Describe an internal tool you built. What did you own, what technical choices did you make, and what was the result?

 - Explain a bug you debugged. What made it tricky, how did you track it down, and what did you learn?

 - What trading-card or collector communities do you understand best? Tell us your favorite card, set, format, deck, rip, or collector niche.



Rare Candy is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate individuality, from Pikachu collectors to Planeswalker pros, and are committed to building an inclusive team.
